_comment: Hand-authored ZAP-shaped alerts for the mock adapter. NOT captured from a live scan:
the authorisation document is unsigned, so no scan has run (CLAUDE.md rules 6-7).
Shapes follow the ZAP /JSON/alert/view/alerts and /JSON/core/view/message responses.
One alert deliberately names a third-party host so ingestion rejection is exercised.

alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security...
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server sets the Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security...
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server sets the Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.name: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
alerts.description: The response does not protect against 'ClickJacking' attacks.
alerts.solution: Modern browsers support the Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive.

alerts.name: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
alerts.description: The Anti-MIME-Sniffing header was not set to 'nosniff'.
alerts.solution: Ensure that the application/web server sets the Content-Type header appropriately.

alerts.name: Timestamp Disclosure - Unix
alerts.description: A timestamp was disclosed by the application/web server.
alerts.solution: Manually confirm that the timestamp data is not sensitive.

alerts.name: Re-examine Cache-control Directives
alerts.description: The cache-control header has not been set properly.
alerts.solution: For secure content, ensure the cache-control HTTP header is set.

alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
